## Item 42 — More avatar motifs + a gentle onboarding pick-your-symbol step

- **Status:** ✅ **DONE `d88d395`** (2026-07-22, Sonnet, low–medium effort, on-device verified — emulator, Claude driving). No schema/Room change (stays **v27** — the `avatar_motif` column + Room v27 already shipped in [v1.6.7.md Item 3 Leg 1](v1.6.7.md#item-3--profile--couple-photo-upload-pulled-from-post-v1-horizon-9)). No grill needed — straight pattern-follow, mirroring the already-shipped Currency onboarding step almost line for line.
- **Request:** Alvin, from a conversation about profile-icon discoverability — the motif-avatar picker (Item 3 Leg 1) only lives in Settings → Profile ([ProfileScreen.kt:157](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/presentation/ProfileScreen.kt#L157)), so a new user never sees it unless they go looking. Asked to (a) add more symbols to the catalog and (b) gently ask new users during onboarding "what symbol represents you best?" instead of leaving it undiscovered.
- **Change:**
  - [MotifAvatar.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/ui/MotifAvatar.kt)'s `AvatarMotif` enum: expand the free catalog (currently 8 — Heart/Leaf/Bloom/Sparkle/Wave/Crescent/Gem/Sprout) with more glyphs from the already-bundled `material-icons-extended` set (no new dependency), in the same soft/nature/couple-friendly register. Exact additions finalized during build. `MotifPicker`'s 4-wide chunked grid needs no change — it already works for any entry count.
  - New `feature/onboarding/presentation/OnboardingMotifScreen.kt` + `OnboardingMotifViewModel.kt`, mirroring [OnboardingCurrencyScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/onboarding/presentation/OnboardingCurrencyScreen.kt) / [OnboardingCurrencyViewModel.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/onboarding/presentation/OnboardingCurrencyViewModel.kt) exactly: reads the current user's `accentColor` (via `ObserveCurrentUserUseCase`) to tint the picker, renders the existing `MotifPicker`, persists instantly on tap via the existing `UpdateAvatarMotifUseCase` (same call `ProfileViewModel.onMotifSelected` already makes — no new use case). Plain "Continue" without tapping anything keeps the Heart default. Copy stays gentle/skippable, not a hard gate — matches the onboarding graph's established low-friction tone (Templates step is "fully skippable").
  - [OnboardingGraph.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/OnboardingGraph.kt): insert the new step between Welcome and Currency (Welcome → **Motif** → Currency → Pair → Templates); bump the four existing "Onboarding step X/4" doc comments to X/5 across `OnboardingWelcomeScreen`, `OnboardingCurrencyScreen`, `OnboardingPairScreen`, `OnboardingTemplatesScreen`.
  - `AvatarMotifTest.catalog_hasEightMotifsWithUniqueKeys` updated to the new count/key list (the other two tests iterate `entries`/fallback keys and auto-cover new additions).
  - **Does not touch:** the `avatar_motif` schema/column (already shipped), the Settings → Profile picker (unchanged — still where to change it later), or ADR-0014's accent-color pairing-flow logic.
- **Build outcome:** catalog expanded to 16 (added Star/Sun/Cloud/Pawprint/Lotus/Pinwheel/Note/Tree — all from `material-icons-extended`, no new dependency); `AvatarMotifTest.catalog_hasSixteenMotifsWithUniqueKeys` updated. `OnboardingGraph.kt` order is Welcome (1/5) → Motif (2/5) → Currency (3/5) → Pair (4/5) → Templates (5/5). `testStagingDebugUnitTest` + `assembleStagingDebug` green.
- **Verify:** on-device (emulator, Claude driving, fresh `testdev42item@iponlove.com` staging account through onboarding end-to-end): new Motif step renders correctly between Welcome and Currency with all 16 motifs in the 4×4 grid, tinted by accent color, Heart pre-selected; tapping Pawprint moved the selection ring + bolded the label (tap-to-select confirmed); "Continue" advanced to Currency (3/5) → Pair (4/5) → Templates (5/5) in correct order; finished onboarding into the app; **Settings → Profile confirmed the pick persisted** (both the top avatar badge and the picker's selection ring show Pawprint), proving the shared `UpdateAvatarMotifUseCase` write landed and the pre-existing Profile picker still works unchanged with the expanded catalog. **Not exercised:** the "Continue without tapping keeps Heart default" path (already covered by `AvatarMotifTest.nullKey_fallsBackToHeartDefault`, same default-seed code path as Currency's own precedent). Throwaway test account left on staging (`testdev42item@iponlove.com`), disclosed.

## Item 43 — Employer reimbursement tracking / general Receivables & Payables module (idea, not booked)

- **Status:** IDEA — parked 2026-07-22, not booked to build. No model/effort chosen — needs a decision first.
- **Context:** Alvin asked whether the app covers "expenses reimbursable by my employer." Today it doesn't as a first-class concept — no counterparty/status field on `transactions`, and `partner_debts` doesn't generalize (its `borrower_id`/`lender_id` are both `users` rows inside a couple, not a non-app third party like an employer or friend). Current workaround: tag expenses with a "Reimbursable" category, log the payback as an Income transaction — no pending/settled tracking or running total like Partner Debt Tracker gives couples.
- **Why parked, not booked:** same problem shape as the personal-loans call already made (personal loans = notes + transactions, no V1 entity — see Product Decisions memory). A real Receivables & Payables module (reimbursements + personal loans + misc IOUs unified, with pending/settled status) would reopen that decision and is genuine new scope, not a mechanical build.
- **Next step if revisited:** run `/grilling` first — cross-cutting (new counterparty concept, new sync-ordered entity, touches the settlement-leg pattern from ADR-0019) — before anything here gets promoted to a real PLANNED item.

## Item 1 — Delete account: Play Console Data Safety web setup

*(originally booked in [v1.6.7.md](v1.6.7.md), held in [v1.6.8.md](v1.6.8.md), moved here 2026-07-22 when v1.6.8 became the widget-fix release — number preserved from v1.6.7)*

- **Status:** PLANNED, not started. **Non-code** — Alvin executes with Claude's guidance when he's ready. **No grilling needed** — this is compliance paperwork (a static page + a Play Console form field), not a design decision; every design call for account deletion itself was already made in [ADR-0045](../adr/0045-delete-account-hard-delete-rpc.md).
- **Request:** the in-app deletion RPC + client teardown shipped in [v1.6.5.md Item 6](v1.6.5.md#item-6--delete-account-play-policy-requirement-) (`9e0614e`+`22d7cc1`, on-device verified), but Google Play's Data Safety policy also requires two things that live outside the app: (1) a publicly reachable "Delete my account" web page, and (2) the Play Console → App content → Data safety form's account-deletion URL pointing at it. Both still pending, flagged as "Alvin, manual" in the v1.6.5/v1.6.6/v1.6.7 write-ups.
- **Guide (when we sit down to do it):** draft a static `delete-account.html` on the existing `alvinleyble.github.io/ipon-love-legal` GitHub Pages site (sibling to `privacy-policy.html`), describing the in-app self-service path (Settings → Profile → Delete account) and what gets removed (per ADR-0045 — full cascade, no retained data, immediate). Push it to the `ipon-love-legal` repo, then fill in the Play Console Data Safety form's deletion-URL field. No app code changes.
- **Verify:** page loads publicly at the URL; Play Console form saves without validation errors.

## Item 44 — Bump targetSdk 35 → 36 (Android 16) for Google Play's Aug 2026 target-API requirement

- **Status:** ✅ **DONE `18a9ed7`** (2026-07-22, booked Sonnet / ran on Opus this session, low–medium effort). Code committed green; **on-device edge-to-edge walk on a real API 36 device is still Alvin's gate before the prod release.** No schema/Room change (stays **v27**). The bump is one line; the effort is the inset verification it triggers, not the code.
- **Build outcome:** [app/build.gradle.kts:27](../../app/build.gradle.kts#L27) `targetSdk = 35` → `36`, single line. `assembleStagingDebug` + `testStagingDebugUnitTest` both green (no new tests — pure config change, no domain/sync/money logic touched). **Inset code-walk done (low regression risk found):** the app already opts into edge-to-edge explicitly — `enableEdgeToEdge()` in both [MainActivity.kt:167](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/MainActivity.kt#L167) and [QuickAddActivity.kt:54](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/widget/presentation/QuickAddActivity.kt#L54), the global `Scaffold` passes `contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0,0,0,0)` and each screen manages its own insets (`statusBarsPadding()` on every title-bearing top-level screen; the custom `PlayfulBottomBar` consumes `WindowInsets.navigationBars` at [IponApp.kt:568](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/IponApp.kt#L568) via the `44e7fd5` follow-up), and the chrome-less Budgets/Accounts/Categories/Combined bodies inherit their host's status-bar padding — so the app never relied on the opt-out API 36 removes, making the bump behaviorally inert for insets. On-device confirmation on a real API 36 device stays the ship gate.
- **Request:** hours after the v1.6.7 closed-testing release, Google Play emailed Alvin the "Your app is affected by Google Play's target API level requirements" warning — Love, Ipon targets an old Android version and must meet the target-API minimum before **Aug 31, 2026**. That deadline's minimum is **API level 36 (Android 16)**; the app currently sets `targetSdk = 35` ([app/build.gradle.kts:27](../../app/build.gradle.kts#L27)). Not blocking yet (updates targeting 35 are still accepted until the deadline, ~5½ weeks out), but the next release should clear it. Deliberately **not** slipped into the v1.6.8 widget-fix AAB — behavior changes need their own tested item.
- **Change:**
  - [app/build.gradle.kts:27](../../app/build.gradle.kts#L27) — `targetSdk = 35` → `36`. `compileSdk` is already **37**, so no SDK-platform/toolchain work is needed (compileSdk ≥ targetSdk holds).
  - **Behavior-change surface to check (this is the real work):** targeting API 36 opts the app into Android 16 behavior changes — chiefly **mandatory edge-to-edge** (the framework stops honoring opt-out of drawing behind the status/nav bars), plus stricter large-screen/orientation handling and background-work rules. Because the Playful Pop reskin recently reworked window insets (v1.6.7 Item 8 + the nav-bar-inset follow-up `44e7fd5`), walk the app for content drawing under or clipped by the system bars and fix any inset regressions at the affected composables/`Scaffold`s. No new ADR — this is a platform-compliance bump, not an architecture decision.
  - **Does not change:** minSdk (stays 26), any feature logic, the paywall/entitlement seam, or sync.
- **Verify:** `assembleStagingDebug` + `testStagingDebugUnitTest` green (pure config change — existing tests just need to still pass; no new tier-1 test — no domain/sync/money logic touched). **On-device is the gate:** install on a real device / emulator running **Android 16 (API 36)** if available (else the highest available) and walk every top-level surface — Records, Analysis, Budgets, Accounts, Categories, Notes, Couple/Combined, Settings, Add/Edit-txn full-screen route, and the home-screen widgets' host — confirming nothing draws under the status/nav bars, no clipped headers/FABs, and the keyboard/IME insets still behave. Fix any edge-to-edge regressions before it ships. Pure Composable/inset verification → verified by running, not unit-tested.
